paths.message: Import useEffectReducer from @/hooks/use-effect-reducer. The package's own version loses effects under StrictMode (#2386); its types are fine to import.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: In Effect code use HttpClient from @effect/platform. Elsewhere in apps/local use httpRequest from @/packages/http.

no-restricted-globals.name: Date
no-restricted-globals.message: In Effect code use Clock or DateTime. Elsewhere in apps/local use now, nowMs or toDate from @/packages/clock; in packages/core use features/time/. Date as a type annotation is fine.
